requirements.item_text: Arrangements are in place to make sure, as far as possible, that medicinal products are stored, distributed and handled afterwards in a way that keeps their quality throughout their shelf life.

requirements.item_text: Medical products are bought, stored, distributed and delivered in a suitable way, in line with legislation, and reach only appropriate recipients.
